sources.name: Frameworks comparison (2026)

sources.note: Local-first crawler, clean markdown out, no per-page fee — runs on our local cloud for bulk niche sweeps.

sources.note: Visual LLM flows for quick internal tools.

sources.note: Email finder (1 credit, only charged on a hit) + verifier (0.5 credit). Free tier is 50 credits/mo — the 50-credit mark to watch.

sources.name: Clay
sources.note: Waterfall enrichment across many providers in one table — best list-building surface today.

sources.name: BBB.org
sources.note: Standing, complaints, and named principals. No public API — verifier agent reads it as a human would, no bulk scraping.

sources.note: Last-resort corroboration of an owner name already found elsewhere. Terms prohibit automated harvesting — keep it manual and logged.
